<style>
:root{--bg:#0d1117;--fg:#e6edf3;--mut:#8b949e;--bd:#30363d}

.wrap{max-width:900px;margin:auto}.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
button{background:#21262d;color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer}
button.on{background:#1f6feb;border-color:#1f6feb}
.box{border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:6px;padding:24px}
img{max-width:100%}.c{text-align:center}.note{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;border:1px dashed var(--bd);border-radius:6px;padding:14px;margin:12px 0}
body.light{--bg:#ffffff;--fg:#1f2328;--mut:#59636e;--bd:#d1d9e0}body.light button{background:#f6f8fa}
</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
